controls.evidence: Steakhouse High Yield USDC (bbqUSDC) at ethereum:0xbeeff2c5bf38f90e3482a8b19f12e5a6d2fca757 is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0xbfe734baab130048e20a64e800c4c2ec25756284 holds 10 enumerated Morpho market IDs. Performance fee 5% of gains, management fee 0%; fee-share accrual is not discretionary minting of underlying USDC. EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots were zero.

review.evidence: Steakhouse High Yield USDC (bbqUSDC) at ethereum:0xbeeff2c5bf38f90e3482a8b19f12e5a6d2fca757 is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0xbfe734baab130048e20a64e800c4c2ec25756284 holds 10 enumerated Morpho market IDs. At ethereum block 26107704 (0x18e5f38), observed 2026-10-02T22:44:15.742108+00:00, receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate were zero and all three setters were abdicated. Reviewed VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom and withdraw/redeem use these gates. sendAssetsGate was zero with its setter not abdicated; it governs deposit/mint, not direct withdrawal or transfer. Deposit-dependent in-kind paths can be constrained by it. USDC freeze exposure is inherited from usdc-circle; this is not a direct share blacklist claim. Local fee/curator authority is not USDC issuer supervision or reserve-liability reconciliation. Calibration provenance (2026-10-03): original umbrella observations retained verbatim: ["Independent human signers and key-custody procedures are not established.", "No exact-vault financial assurance or statutory holder priority was established."]. Human independence and key custody remain unverified and are priced by their dedicated control signals; financial/legal safeguards remain Backing-domain gaps. Calibration v2 (2026-10-03) reconsidered every prior removal and scoped move. Prior scoped observations retained verbatim: []. Genuine unknown implementation, controller authorization and unreadable execution state are retained as umbrella questions; identified-signer custody/independence is recorded per control, not asserted to be independently scored or resolved. Field re-justification: reconciliation=not-applicable concerns the bounded asset-backed native share-issuance path, not a declaration of independently audited financial reconciliation. Underlying USDC issuance/assurance remains inherited; supervision=none grants no prudential credit, and exact-vault financial assurance and statutory holder priority remain unverified in Backing evidence.
